newsitem.title: USA: US debt futures end lower, rattled by Fed comments.
newsitem.headline: US debt futures end lower, rattled by Fed comments.

text.p: Sept 17 - U.S. debt futures ended lower, rattled by a senior Fed official's comments that eight of 12 Fed banks requested discount rate hike. Three of the eight favor a 50-bps-hike.
Dec T-bonds set a session low late in the day at 108-01/32, as the market was unable to generate any bounce off the lows.
